result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate for convenience on 30 days’ written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, and pays no early-termination fee; Vendor has no convenience-termination right during a term. The change is targeted and preserves the existing for-cause and insolvency rights. Drafting is substantively clear, but the new paragraph should be numbered (preferably as Section 9.4) and placed before existing Section 9.5.
